factors: Ten source cues covering the substantive hardware and context claims
Distinct maker specifications, multiple community tests and contradictory MTP evidence
Seven claim records, three Reader comparisons, and a separately labeled SharePlane Work connection
complexity.rationale: The video combines distinct GPU configurations and context claims that require extended architectural math, counterevidence, and a falsifiable workload-specific decision.

sourceMap.rationale: Opening premise is mapped to source first-screen claim, not independently verified performance.
Cache cost is a source-reported topic checked against the maker configuration.
Quantization weight fit is separated from occupied total memory.
The short-context RTX 3080 result is source-reported and configuration-specific.
MTP acceleration is conditional and opposed by other measurements.
The RTX 3060 longer-context result is not conflated with the 3080 run.
Two-card pooled context is not presented as a single 12 GB capability.
The sizing calculation is a filter, not an independent hardware benchmark.
The populated-context cost is linked to the bounded qualification proposal.
The final source claim is distinguished from the GhostMesh earned verdict.

sourceCoverage.rationale: Ten distinct, exact timestamped source cues map to four appropriate analytical sections and seven bounded claim records; private aid was not independently audiovisual-certified.

supportingArgument.rationale: Maker architecture config and original GGUF inventories support the memory arithmetic, while configuration-specific community reports illustrate conditional capacity and throughput.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Maker specifications, community observations, source-video assertions, contrary MTP comparisons and GhostMesh synthesis are explicitly separated.

counterargument.rationale: A faster reported short-context rate does not prove usable long-context throughput, while MTP evidence includes contradictory community results.

tradeoffs.rationale: Quantization, KV cache, compute buffers, bandwidth, prefill, model quality and possible CPU offload impose different costs on a nominal 12 GB deployment.

falsifiability.rationale: Two bounded matched recipes evaluate actual prompt-assist latency and long-context citation accuracy with specified hardware, context, hashes and output measures.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The three-budget framing separates model fit, sustained speed and accepted workload quality and avoids treating dissimilar runs as a purchase promise.

performance.rationale: The cited community RTX 3060, RTX 3080, dual-GPU and MTP results are not independently reproduced; effective sustained speed remains workload-specific.

economics.rationale: A smaller model or lower precision is warranted when it preserves actual task quality with less contention; any additional memory expense requires demonstrated benefit.

threatGovernance.rationale: The Reader preserves private caption and transcript custody, explicitly qualifies source date, and does not elevate externally reported benchmarks to production authorization.

ownerDecision.reason: Tony accepted the current Reader presentation direction for future use, but has not issued an explicit exact-head production publish authorization.

gaps.rationale: Private captions and source video timing were not independently verified by a complete audiovisual listen-through.
Community hardware benchmarks and full populated-context task quality were not independently replicated.
Independent reviewer did not certify native iPhone rendering, production deployment or site publication.

decisionRationale: Independent editorial reviewer accepted corrected authored HTML and source-map bytes after three mechanical linkage corrections, preserving the locked argument, honest source provenance, and bounded evidence posture. Publication remains separately owner-gated.
